suggested_rules.name: DATA_BREACH_NOTIFICATION_REQUIRED
suggested_rules.reason: No explicit rule covers GDPR Articles 33 and 34 breach notification timelines.
suggested_rules.ocl:
context Trace
inv DATA_BREACH_NOTIFICATION_REQUIRED:
    for all e where e.name = detect_personal_data_breach:
        exists g where g.name = notify_supervisory_authority AND g.order > e.order

suggested_rules.name: CONSENT_WITHDRAWAL_STOP_PROCESSING
suggested_rules.reason: Consent withdrawal is not explicitly connected to halting subsequent processing.
suggested_rules.ocl:
context Trace
inv CONSENT_WITHDRAWAL_STOP_PROCESSING:
    for all e where e.name = withdraw_consent:
        not exists p where p.type = DATA_PROCESSING AND p.order > e.order

suggested_rules.name: DPIA_HIGH_RISK_PROCESSING_REQUIRED
suggested_rules.reason: High-risk or special-category processing should be linked to a DPIA evidence event.
suggested_rules.ocl:
context Trace
inv DPIA_HIGH_RISK_PROCESSING_REQUIRED:
    if context.data_category in {SPECIAL, HEALTH}:
        exists g where g.name = perform_dpia AND g.order < first(DATA_PROCESSING).order
